supersedes.reason: The 2026-09-18 packet bound the two formal-gate status records at their living paths. Those records are not immutable: a status record moves whenever a gate moves, and data/phase8-launch-readiness-exit-status.json holds cdn-tile-validation, which by design goes to fail whenever the Explore client changes and back to pass when the Site is redeployed and re-observed. An admission record is a statement about a moment, so binding it to a file that legitimately changes afterwards made the assertion break on ordinary work and break again on the repair. It first broke on 2026-09-19, when this branch changed the Explore client. The correction freezes the exact bytes each pin already named into a dated snapshot and binds that instead. The sha256 and byteLength of both bindings are unchanged, because the bytes are unchanged; only the path moves. The snapshots were extracted from git history and verified against the checksums this packet already carried, so no new claim is made and nothing was re-measured. The owner decision being recorded is the same 2026-09-18 decision on items A to F. This packet does not re-decide anything, and it does not edit the 2026-09-18 packet or record, which stay on disk as written.
supersedes.meaning: This is the same 2026-09-18 decision, re-recorded against bindings that cannot go stale. The superseded record and packet are not edited and remain on disk; this record does not re-decide any item, and the owner approved the correction of the evidence shape, not a new admission.

admittedItems.A-base-rasters: The national annual raster batch every other item is computed from: 39 forest masks and 38 annual loss rasters, 1984-2022.
admittedItems.B-province-annual-series-and-union: Each province's 38 annual losses and the 1984-2022 loss counted once per place.
admittedItems.C-province-span-aggregate: Loss counted once per place, forest known at the start year, unknown area, and yearly losses added together, for all 741 spans, for BC, AB, ON and QC. The four-province figure is the sum of the four, which is exact because provinces are disjoint.
admittedItems.D-district-span-figures: Loss for all 741 spans in each federal and provincial electoral district.
admittedItems.E-per-cell-patch-archives: 38 annual per-cell loss patch archives, zoom 8-14, already served from CloudFront.
admittedItems.F-coarse-grid: 960 m union-and-sum grid for draw and measure, any span 1984-2022.

limits: Every province is partial-with-unknown, so every figure is a minimum. Unmapped share of the cartographic province: QC 15.04962%, ON 9.03031%, AB 24.02146%, BC 0.00446%.
Loss is counted once per place, against the forest known at the start year. Yearly losses added together carry no percentage.
Unmapped and nodata cells stay Unknown and are never shown as no loss.
Nothing has been expert reviewed. Independent comparisons are not published.
Harvest and wildfire on patches are overlaps with recorded events, not causal attribution.
